codex.label: OpenAI Codex
codex.notes: Uses the Agent Skills SKILL.md format. CODEX_HOME is honored when set.

cursor.label: Cursor
cursor.notes: Project skill path verified. This installer does not guess a global path.

windsurf.label: Windsurf
windsurf.notes: Official docs currently document Rules and Workflows, not portable SKILL.md installation. No skill files are installed.

gemini-cli.label: Gemini CLI
gemini-cli.notes: Also discovers the shared .agents/skills alias; the explicit Gemini path is used here.

opencode.label: OpenCode
opencode.notes: Native project and user paths; OpenCode also reads some compatibility directories.

github-copilot.label: GitHub Copilot
github-copilot.notes: Locations vary by Copilot surface; personal skills are available in Copilot CLI and supported clients.
